# Vault Daily Log

Appends quick thoughts, work logs, or decisions into today's journal note (`Journal/Daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md`).

## Protocol
1. Locate or create `Journal/Daily/<today's date>.md` using `Template - Journal Daily.md`.
2. Append the item under the appropriate section (`## Work & Execution Log`, `## Brain Dump`, etc.).
3. Update `last updated` timestamp.
